summary: This is a DeepSeek Harness local service control plugin that lets users and agents manage projects through a web panel and tools, including registering services, starting/stopping/restarting them, and handling port conflicts with shared local state.

classificationSuggestion.reason: This plugin is best classified as automation tooling for local development operations: it integrates a DSH web panel and agent-facing tools to discover/register services, manage start-stop-restart actions, and coordinate service metadata through a shared local registry with port conflict handling. Risk is moderate because it can launch/stop local processes and writes control state/logs, but it appears scoped to local project service management rather than remote system administration.
